tasks.title: Create immutable store objects and profile generations
tasks.goal: Represent reusable payload storage and per-environment generations without confusing content identity with physical ownership.
steps: Build generation manifests referencing verified immutable payloads, generated configuration/catalog and activation links; keep mutable data and secrets outside.
Permit shared verified content while retaining independent instance/principal/profile authority and prefix constraints.
Expose list/inspect/verify model views with corruption detection and explicit legacy observations.
positive_cases: Two profiles share one immutable dependency yet have separate active generations.
A previous generation stays readable after creating a replacement.
negative_cases: A mutable config file is hashed as immutable package payload.
Content equality is interpreted as permission to adopt another profile.

tasks.title: Apply HOME installs and dependency-safe removal
tasks.goal: Deliver install/update/remove over exact owned effects with command and reverse-dependency checks.
steps: Expose proposed environment operations through the shared application service; keep existing bare install semantics unchanged.
Prepare complete old/new footprint, command conflicts and reverse-dependency effects before writing; use exact grants and retained configuration before-state.
Activate only verified generations; preserve user-modified configuration and shared dependencies during removal, returning typed conflict/disposition needs.
positive_cases: Install two tools sharing a dependency, update one and remove it without breaking the other.
A user-edited config survives an update/removal with a reviewable conflict.
negative_cases: Removing a required dependency silently breaks another command.
HOME unwritability leaves a successful status or an unowned partial file.

tasks.title: Execute commands through explicit environment activation
tasks.goal: Run installed commands with the correct target closure and controlled shell activation.
steps: Add explicit environment exec/shell entry points backed by selected generation and verified command ownership.
Construct PATH/library/runtime bindings from the declared closure; keep invocation working directory, principal and target ABI explicit.
Exercise independent profiles/versions and prefix-bound incompatibility; Linux target commands never run directly in the Windows controller.
positive_cases: Each of two profiles invokes its own selected command version.
A relocatable tool runs under a non-default injected HOME prefix.
negative_cases: Ambient PATH shadows the chosen installed executable.
Wrong-platform binary dispatch falls through to host execution.
